description:
The School of Classical Ballet and Western Dance was founded in 1966 by Tushna Dallas with just four pupils. Since then, the school has grown and built its credibility in the field of dance education for more than five decades. Today, the school functions under the direction of Khushcheher Dallas, fondly known as Khooshoo.
The School has been promoting the growth of Western Classical Ballet in India since its establishment. We offer training to those who wish to study and imbibe the discipline of dance. Besides Ballet, other dance forms like Modern Theatre and Latin American are also taught at the School.
We emphasize on achieving technical proficiency while ensuring that the essence of dance is not lost.

By introducing them to a wide range of choreography and styles, they broadened their understanding and allowed them to develop their own unique artistic voices.

They emphasized the importance of discipline, perseverance, and teamwork, instilling in them a strong work ethic and a resilient spirit. Their mentorship extended beyond the studio, shaping my daughters' character and preparing them for success in all aspects of life.

The impact of The School of Classical Ballet and Western Dance on both my daughters' lives goes far beyond their skills as dancers. They have become role models and trusted mentors, providing guidance and support during both the triumphs and the challenges. Their unwavering belief in my daughters' abilities has fostered a sense of self-confidence that will undoubtedly serve them well in their future endeavors.

I am eternally grateful to them for their dedication and unwavering commitment over the past decade. They have not only nurtured the growth of my daughters as dancers but have also left an indelible mark on their hearts and minds. The memories, experiences, and skills they have gained under their guidance will stay with them for a lifetime.

If you are searching for a ballet teacher who is truly exceptional, I wholeheartedly recommend The School of Classical Ballet and Western Dance. Their profound knowledge, passion for ballet, and ability to inspire and mentor students make them a truly remarkable educator. Good luck and God bless!

I’ve been surprised at how quickly I’ve been able to pick up steps I once thought were impossible.

But beyond just learning dance, this class has become something I genuinely look forward to every time. It’s not just about the choreography—it’s about the confidence I’ve gained, the stress I’ve let go of, and the fun I’ve had along the way. There’s something really special about being in a space where everyone is learning, laughing, and growing together.

Looking back, my best experience hasn’t been just one moment—it’s been the entire journey so far. From my first hesitant steps to now feeling more expressive and confident, this class has truly been amazing. I’m so grateful I took that first step and joined.

I would wholeheartedly recommend this class to anyone, especially beginners like me. It’s more than just a dance class—it’s an experience that lifts you up in every way.
